rule: Three owners, one clock. World process polls once per real minute and sends broadcasts and world reloads to all zones. Each zone polls once per real minute and toggles hot-zone, rule and content-flag state in memory, clearing its active list when a window ends. A per-zone integer (spawn condition) drives camps: spawn events move it on a period measured in EQ minutes (3 real seconds each); when it crosses a spawn point's threshold, the point despawns, repops, repops if ready, or signals its mob (signal number = on_change minus 10). Strict spawn events fire only inside a short window after their trigger; missed windows are skipped. Windows are start/end calendar fields with 0 meaning 'use now', or a cron expression with a 10-second pad. A non-cron broadcast with no end fires every minute poll from its start (read from code; not run).

data_fields.name: spawn_event_action
data_fields.unit: enum: set, add, subtract, multiply, divide

data_fields.name: on_change
data_fields.unit: enum: nothing, despawn, repop, repop_if_ready, signal (base 10)

keep: Split world-scope rows (broadcast, reload) from zone-scope rows (hot zone, rule, content flag).
Threshold-to-signal chain: a counter crossing a line makes spawn points act, one chosen action each.
Strict window: a missed trigger is skipped, not replayed after a restart.
Cron window with a short pad rather than exact-second matching.
Once-a-minute poll that re-reads the events table only when it changed.
change: Make start and end explicit; drop zero-means-now, which drifts for partial windows and cannot express midnight.
Add a fire-once latch per event id, so a broadcast cannot repeat every poll while its window is open.
Put the banner on the server ledger, one row per event start, and let the client only draw from that row.
Replace the single yellow chat line with a 375-wide banner with a countdown and one NPC line.
look_test: On the existing phone build, compare three ways to show one zone event at 375 wide: (a) plain yellow chat line only; (b) top banner with one NPC bark and a 10-second countdown; (c) banner plus ground marker where the camp changes. Dom judges in three seconds whether he can say what started and where. Then restart the server mid-event: the banner must replay once, not repeat.
